name: lankora-microservices
description: Lankora Sri Lanka Tourism Platform Microservices Architecture

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix places-service && npm install --prefix booking-service && npm install --prefix review-service && npm install --prefix itinerary-service
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PLACES,BOOKING,REVIEW,ITINERARY" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,red" "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix places-service" "npm run dev --prefix booking-service" "npm run dev --prefix review-service" "npm run dev --prefix itinerary-service"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PLACES,BOOKING,REVIEW,ITINERARY" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,red" "npm run start --prefix api-gateway" "npm run start --prefix auth-service" "npm run start --prefix places-service" "npm run start --prefix booking-service" "npm run start --prefix review-service" "npm run start --prefix itinerary-service"
